parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in assays against human D2 dopamine receptor (CHEMBL217) in Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL217 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
